preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty and its length must not exceed 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of '(' and ')' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' if not any(any(c in '()' for c in s) for s in substrings) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no valid regular bracket sequences, the output must be '0 1'.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.split()[0]) == max(len(s) for s in substrings if is_regular(s))
postconditions.description: The first part of the output must be the length of the longest regular bracket sequence found.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.split()[1]) == sum(1 for s in substrings if is_regular(s) and len(s) == int(stdout.split()[0]))
postconditions.description: The second part of the output must be the count of the longest regular bracket sequences.
